patho.caption_source: Minimally-displaced fracture in right mandibular body seen by oral surgeon. Arrow marks fracture with two fracture lines showing the fracture is through the medial and lateral cortex of the mandible, root canal on central incisor, wisdom teeth in place. Note that the teeth to the left of the fracture do not touch the upper teeth
